Our Story

WE ARE
HOMEGROWN.

Homegrown Baseball was built on a simple idea: the best players aren't discovered somewhere else — they're developed right here, on the fields of Mililani, by coaches who live and breathe this community.

We don't recruit from the mainland. We don't chase shortcuts. We grow our players from the ground up — with elite instruction, relentless reps, and the kind of aloha spirit that makes Hawaii baseball different from anywhere else on earth.

Whether your kid is picking up a bat for the first time or chasing a D1 scholarship, Homegrown has a place for them.

Why Choose Us

THE HOMEGROWN
DIFFERENCE

ELITE TRAINING

Structured development programs across every age group — from fundamentals to advanced mechanics. Our coaches bring college and pro experience to every practice.

COMMUNITY FAMILY

Baseball is more than a game here — it's how Mililani families connect. Team events, parent meetups, and a community that shows up for each other on and off the field.

HAWAII PROUD

We represent Mililani everywhere we play — with aloha, with grit, and with the pride of knowing we were raised right here on the best island on earth.

Get In The Game

OUR PROGRAMS

Age-based divisions built around player development, competition, and aloha. Every kid has a place at Homegrown.

4U
Tee Ball
Ages 4–5

Introductory baseball where kids learn the basics — batting stance, fielding, base running — in a fun, low-pressure environment.

Focus: Fundamentals · Fun · First steps
6U
Pinto / Coach Pitch
Ages 6–7

Coach-pitched games to develop timing, hand-eye coordination, and team concepts. Where competitive instincts start forming.

Focus: Timing · Teamwork · Competition
REGIONALS BOUND
8U
Mustang / Player Pitch
Ages 8–9

Player-pitched baseball with real game situations. Our 8U squad competed at the Cal Ripken PSW Regionals in Phoenix — this is where Homegrown shines.

Focus: Pitching · Game IQ · Tournament Play
10U
Bronco Division
Ages 10–11

Full-field baseball with advanced mechanics, pitching development, and tournament-level competition across Oahu and beyond.

Focus: Advanced mechanics · State Playoffs
12U
Pony Division
Ages 12–13

Elite-level travel baseball for athletes ready to compete at the highest regional and national levels. Where future prospects are built.

Focus: Recruiting Exposure · Nationals
DON'T SEE YOUR AGE GROUP?

Reach out — we're always building new teams and age groups based on community need.
